author: Warhammer
description:
Dread assassins of forbidding aspect, Mortis Reapers slip behind enemy lines to target vulnerable leaders. Check out this video to discover everything you need to know when it comes to painting them – from their unique reaper’s blades to their iconic dark-bone bodies.

Here’s a list of the paints and tools we used in today’s video:

Base:
Abaddon Black
Balthasar Gold
Dryad Bark
Gal Vorbak Red
Incubi Darkness
Khorne Red
Mechanicus Standard Grey
Morghast Bone
Stegadon Scale Green
Steel Legion Drab

Layer:
Administratum Grey
Kabalite Green
Moot Green
Stormhost Silver
Stormvermin Fur
Sybarite Green
Ushabti Bone
Warpstone Glow
Wazdakka Red

Contrast:
Shyish Purple
Black Legion

Shade:
Nuln Oil
Reikland Fleshshade

Technical:
Lahmian Medium
Astrogranite

Tools:
S Dry
M Base
S Layer
M Layer
